contentList.content: Homeless Californian

Hardened by the concrete jungles of San Francisco and Los Angeles, the Homeless Californian channels makeshift biological warfare, erratic street fury, and the gravity-defying equilibrium of the legendary Fent Lean.
Tenderloin Biohazard
Master of chemical concoctions and sidewalk biohazards. Amplifies the potency of toxic clouds, explosive biological payloads, and turns environmental hazards into personal restoration.
Venice Boardwalk Brawler
A ferocious close-quarters pugilist specializing in improvised shivs, reckless flurries, and chaotic shopping cart charges.
BART Platform Menace
An erratic street phantom who slips through turnstiles and spatial dimensions, unleashing ear-piercing 3 AM screeches to disorient and terrorize foes.
Sling Poop
Hurl a handful of raw biological waste at a target. Deals 1d6 Bludgeoning + 1d4 Poison damage, coats the ground in a repulsive slick, and inflicts Fecal Stench.
Sling Chunky Poop
Hurl a dense, fermented biological projectile with devastating force. Deals 2d6 Bludgeoning + 2d6 Poison damage, spreading an expanded slick and inflicting severe Fecal Stench.
Sling Fentanyl
Launch a concentrated chemical dose at an enemy. Deals 1d4 Psychic damage, spawns a toxic narcotic haze, and forces a DC Constitution Saving Throw or the target is paralyzed in Fent Stupor.
Mass Fentanyl Contraband
Scatter an entire contraband brick across a wide area. Creates an expansive narcotic fog that numbs, slows, and incapacitates all caught within.
Fent Lean

Assume the ultimate posture of street invulnerability: rigidly fold forward at a perfect 90-degree waist angle. Gain resistance to ALL damage, complete immunity to Knockdown, Prone, Shove, and Psychic effects, and +3 AC due to your bewildering center of gravity. Your movement speed is reduced to 0.
Snap Out of Lean
Forcefully snap your spine back into vertical alignment, regaining normal mobility.
Sidewalk Scramble
Sprint across the battlefield with reckless street urgency, ignoring difficult terrain such as broken glass, grease, and mud.
Aggressive Panhandling
Corner an enemy and aggressively demand spare coin or life essence. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or drop their weapons in terror and become Frightened for 2 turns.
Feral Screech
Unleash an unhinged, high-decibel 3 AM sidewalk wail. Foes within 9m take 3d6 Psychic damage and become Deafened and Frightened.
Tent City Sanctuary
Erect an impromptu tarp shelter perimeter. Allies within the encampment gain 15 Temporary Hit Points and cannot be targeted by ranged attacks for 3 turns.
Broken Bottle Shank
Viciously stab an adjacent target with a jagged glass bottle. Deals 1d8 Piercing damage and inflicts heavy Bleeding.
Shopping Cart Charge
Barreling forward behind a squeaky shopping cart, rush up to 9m and slam into a target, dealing 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and knocking them Prone.
Turnstile Hop
Effortlessly hurdle through urban dimensional barriers, teleporting up to 12m as a Bonus Action.
Fent Lean
Locked in the legendary 90-degree fold. Immune to Knockdown, Prone, and Psychic damage. Resistant to ALL damage. +3 AC. Movement speed is 0.
Fecal Stench
Coated in raw, rank bio-waste. Sickened by the odor, suffering Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and -3m Movement Speed.
Fent Stupor
Severe narcotic stupor and respiratory depression. Incapacitated, unable to take actions or reactions, and movement speed reduced to 0.
Sidewalk Scramble
Movement speed increased by 4.5m and immune to difficult terrain.
Panhandled Terror
Terrified by aggressive personal space violations. Frightened and suffering Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Street Grit Defense
While not wearing armor, your tough skin and street instincts add both your Constitution and Dexterity modifiers to your Armor Class.
Sidewalk Immunity
Years of dumpster exposure have forged an impenetrable immune system. Immune to Disease and Poisoned, and resistant to Poison damage.
Restorative Stupor
While locked in the Fent Lean, your slowed metabolic rate knits wounds back together, restoring 2d6 Hit Points at the start of every turn.
Baffling Retaliation
While in Fent Lean, melee attackers attempting to strike your bewildering posture strike bone-jarring equilibrium, suffering 1d10 Psychic damage.
